LESSON: READING 3.2.2 PHONIC AWARENESS OF THE MANUAL LETTER SOUNDS (A-E)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.2: Reading 3.2.2 Phonic awareness of the manual letter sounds (a-e)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 3.2.2 Phonic awareness of the manual letter sounds (a-e), part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: What pictures do you enjoy reading? 2.Which letter sounds have you heard from other learners?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 3.2.2 Phonic awareness of the manual letter sounds (a-e) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Respect:Etiquette as learner reads out the letter sounds in pairs and groups and appreciates how each one reads.

• Responsibility: Excellence as learner reads out signs the letter sound independently and matches corresponding objects whose

name begins with the letter sounds.

PCIs

Citizenship: social cohesion as learner reads out the letter sounds together and chant them together learning to appreciate one

another and living in harmony.

Link to other Learning Area:

Learner relates as learner chantings rhymes to promote phonic awareness with chanting in music activities.
